scope: Bounded primary-source audit, not a systematic or exhaustive review. Access status describes text actually available to the root researcher. Delegated access claims remain in the signed-by-agent prose reports, not human peer review.

sources.title: Optimizer's Information Criterion: Dissecting and Correcting Bias in Data-Driven Optimization, v4
sources.finding: Composite optimizer corrections and integrated iid-context OIC already exist. Merely adding contextual features or a covariance term is not novelty.

sources.title: Data-Driven Distributionally Robust CVaR Portfolio Optimization Under A Regime-Switching Ambiguity Set
sources.finding: Regime-switching/HMM uncertainty and CVaR portfolio DRO predate this proposal. This does not establish equivalence of every possible future construction.

sources.title: Relative robust portfolio optimization with Value-at-Risk and Conditional Value-at-Risk
sources.finding: Relative CVaR robust portfolio comparison is established. The exact coverage of continuous-mixture fixed-action certificates was not settled by abstract-level access.

sources.title: On the Concavity of Expected Shortfall
sources.access: FULL_PDF; theorem, proof and final priority acknowledgement inspected
sources.finding: ES concavity in distribution mixtures is known. The author explicitly acknowledges earlier Proposition 3.2 by Pertaia and Uryasev.

sources.title: Fitting heavy-tailed mixture models with CVaR constraints
sources.access: DRAFT_PRIMARY_PDF_FETCH_FAILED_502; published author PDF also timed out; title/DOI verified from primary indexed PDF; priority attribution verified in Tselishchev full paper; direct full text NOT_VERIFIED
sources.finding: Do not claim direct verification of Proposition 3.2 from this inaccessible PDF.

sources.title: Distributionally Robust Regret Minimization
sources.access: FULL_HTML; introduction and regret definitions inspected
sources.finding: Robust regret is established. CVaR of pathwise regret must not be substituted for a difference of two CVaRs.

sources.title: Conditional covariance penalties for mixed models
sources.finding: Conditional covariance penalties are known; terminal time-series risk is a distinct estimand that requires an actual derivation.

sources.title: Estimation of Downside Risks in Project Portfolio Selection
sources.finding: Selection-induced downside-risk distortion is not a new problem introduced by this project.

sources.title: Optimization of Conditional Value-at-Risk
sources.access: KNOWN_FORMULATION; citation checked in delegated audit and concavity paper; original full article NOT_READ this turn
sources.finding: The threshold minimization is treated as established baseline mathematics, independently checked against risk-envelope LP in code.

search_limits: 30 root search queries (28 research queries plus two metadata checks), plus targeted primary-source opens; agent query logs retained separately.
No database-completeness, priority, patentability, or paper-acceptance claim.
Full copyrighted article text and raw web-tool excerpts are not redistributed.
Source names/links are leads only where full text was unavailable; no absence-of-result novelty inference.
